## Summary

- What user problem does this change solve?
- Which processing or export path is affected?

## Verification

- [ ] `node --check app.js`
- [ ] `node --check sw.js`
- [ ] `node tests/smoke.mjs`
- [ ] Repeated processing tested
- [ ] Parameter changes invalidate old output
- [ ] Relevant export tested

## Accuracy and privacy

- [ ] Copy does not describe generated or interpolated detail as lossless recovery
- [ ] Selected image pixels remain local to the browser
- [ ] New dependency versions and licenses are documented
